verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform. A platform like this could plausibly ship a built-in assistant in its dashboard or developer console, so the story applies. The evidence documents only APIs, a sandbox, webhooks and an llms.txt docs index; the llms.txt file makes the docs machine-readable but is not an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
